about: Incorporated in 1988 as a JV between Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd. (AHEL) and the Delhi Government, Indraprastha Medical Corporation Ltd. is a super speciality tertiary care hospital in New Delhi. The Co. currently has 52 speciality departments. [1]
